notes: INSIDE half of the Shrapnel Cannon (scrap): the funnel spout that feeds the breech with scrap, mismatched cans, repair hatch, amber lamp strip. charge: lamps fill; fire: the strip stutters. damaged: spout dented, lamps dead; disabled: dark, cracked.
